metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2026 · Avatar: Seven Havens
metas.description: After a world-shattering disaster, a young Earthbender learns she's the post-Korra Avatar. Now seen as a harbinger of doom, she and her twin race to save the Seven Havens while pursued by humans and spirits alike.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2024 · Among Us
metas.description: Members of your crew have been replaced by an alien shapeshifter intent on causing confusion, sabotaging the ship, and killing everyone. Root out the 'Impostor' or fall victim to its murderous designs.
